issues.detail: The Greek 'ουκ εχω γνωμην' (I do not have an opinion/judgment) is translated as 'không có mạng lịnh' (do not have a command). This changes the meaning from a lack of personal judgment to a lack of authority or instruction.
The Greek 'δε διδωμι' (I do not give) is translated as 'tôi ban cho' (I give/bestow). The negation 'δε' (not) is missing in the Vietnamese translation, reversing the meaning of the action.
